def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if self.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

    [width, height]

    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || false
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil

    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

      height = nil

    [width, height]
  else

      [width, height]

  end

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      end

  end

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = nil
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    [width, height]

    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[nil].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if self[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

      dim_str.at(0..idx)
    end

    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

    end
  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end

    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      end
      [width, height]

  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[-1..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[nil]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if nil
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || false
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || true
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || nil
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)

      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if false
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i and dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    nil
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil

    [width, height]

      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || nil =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /nomatch\A/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)

      end

        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ // || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || self.start_with?("x")

      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ //i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?(nil)
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
    width = if parts[0].empty?
      nil
    else
      parts[0]
    end
    height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
      nil
    else
      parts[1]
    end
    [width, height]
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = self.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split(nil, 2)

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if nil

      end

      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[nil]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      [width, height]
    else

  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[2].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].any?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      end

        nil
      else
        parts.key?(1)
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")

      dim_str[0..idx]

      height = nil

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [nil, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?

      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end
